scope: Complete original English short poems, retaining dialect, spelling, punctuation and stanza boundaries; no numeric line cap. Extended works and translations remain in exclusion ledger, never split.
retrieval: Official browser-derived complete plaintext, LF-reconstructed; checksum identifies reconstruction not HTTP response bytes.
extraction: Pinned source plus explicit reviewed boundary/verse-line ledger; italics underscores and footnote callouts removed as apparatus. No text modernization.
notes: Complete current1911 transcription, not older GITenberg partial collection.
Bird-Gods plaintext physical lines joined in28 explicit pairs verified against official HTML; no inferred general unwrapping rule.
After Romney means after a portrait and is not a translation. Natural Theology is original English poem quoting reported speech; author introduction identifies his own composition.
F. P. and A. D. signatures preserved as authors; Double Ballade of Primitive Man explicitly co-credited E. B. Tylor.
Translations and classical adaptations excluded per specific source headings and notes; Scots verse remains eligible.
